senses.definition: n.f. blossom (perhaps from above √, blossom, flower, as shining amid leaves);—abs. נ׳ of vine Is 18:5 (‖ פֶּרַח; = berry-cluster according to Di Kit CheHpt. cf. J. Derenb ZAW v (1885), 301 f.; vi (1886). 98 f.); sf. נִצָּתוֹ Jb 15:33 (of olive); read also נִצָּתָהּ Gn 40:10 (of vine) for MT נִצָּהּ, cf. Di Holz.
